About the Position

This Inland Norway PhD fellowship connects bioinformatics and machine learning with the diagnosis of infection and antimicrobial resistance. It is an employed doctoral research position, with the research task and formal qualification requirements set out in the employer's advert. University of Inland Norway is seeking candidates for this PhD opportunity focused on Bioinformatics and Machine Learning for Infection and AMR, Inland Norway. The work sits within Bioinformatics, Machine Learning. The host institution is in Various, Norway. According to the listing, funding covers the full cost of participation; financial support is listed as NOK 550,800/year gross (Norwegian state salary plan 17.510, code 1017). Applications close 5 November 2026.

Research Areas

  • Bioinformatics
  • Machine learning
  • Antimicrobial resistance
